preconditions.description: The number of planets is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of plans is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The index of the earth is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The type of the plan is between 1 and 3, inclusive.
The indices of the planets are between 1 and n, inclusive.
The cost of the plan is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains n integers, one for each planet.

postconditions.expression: output[i-1] == 0 if i == s else output[i-1] >= 0
postconditions.description: The cost to get from the earth to the earth is 0, and for all other planets it is the minimum cost to get there, or -1 if it is impossible.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or output[i] >= 0 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: All outputs are either the minimum cost to get to that planet or -1 if it is impossible.
